text: South African Government said on X that asylum seekers and refugees are not allowed to vote, citing refugee regulations and the Electoral Act.

sources.verified: linked from gov.za, its official website

[Text and content of the image] OF THE DAY
Asylum seekers

not allowed to vote
Refugee Regulations - Regulations 4(1)(g) and 4(1)(i)
explicitly prohibit refugees and asylum seekers from
participating in any political activity or campaign in
furtherance of any political party or interests within
South Africa. They are also barred from voting or
participating in political campaigns related to their
countries of origin without specific ministerial approval.
